quarterly_data.quarter: 3M press release: 3M and AWS collaborate to advance optical connectivity (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 3M says its expanded collaboration with AWS and related investments are expected to support more than 500 jobs directly and indirectly, including the creation of more than 100 new roles through 2027 across Minnesota, Texas and Wisconsin (customer co-innovation, technology advancement and supply chain development across its optical networking portfolio), and that it expects to contribute nearly $0.5 billion to the U.S. economy through its optical connectivity business to accelerate innovation in optical networking and fiber termination and enable commercialization at scale. The collaboration builds on 3M's announcement earlier this year that it will double production capacity at its Menomonie, Wisconsin, manufacturing facility.
quarterly_data.figure: more than 500 jobs; more than 100 new roles through 2027; nearly $0.5 billion

contracts.source: 3M press release: 3M and AWS collaborate to advance optical connectivity (10-21-2026)
contracts.signal: 3M and Amazon Web Services announced an expanded strategic collaboration: AWS plans to deploy and scale 3M's Expanded Beam Optical (EBO) platform for its data center infrastructure, and the two will advance co-innovation and investment in optical connectivity (release headline: 'AWS is investing in 3M's Expanded Beam Optical technology for its data center infrastructure'). Group President Wendy Bauer: AWS's adoption of the EBO platform 'demonstrates the potential of our optical connectivity technology'. Amazon's VP of Supply Chain & Procurement Jens Gruenkemeir cites the hundreds of jobs being supported by 3M as a result of its collaboration with Amazon.
